AlignSpec.description: Bit position of a custom raw format.

oneOf.description: Valid bits are the low bits.
Valid bits are the high bits.

prefer.description: The backend the node would like to run on; a warning if it is not available.

require.description: The backend the node must run on; `backend_unavailable` if it is not available.

ContainerSpec.description: Container of a custom raw format.

CustomFormat.description: A custom raw format, mapped to `sdrk_device::SampleFormat`.

align.description: Position of the valid bits inside the container.

swap_iq.description: If true, the first value of each pair is Q (default false).

oneOf.description: `push` fails with `OutputFull` before it consumes anything.
The oldest data of the output is discarded to make room.
New data that does not fit is discarded.

from.description: Name of the source (an input or a node).

to.description: Name of the destination (a node or an output).

EndianSpec.description: Byte order of a custom raw format.

FormatName.description: A well-known raw format by name.

anyOf.description: One of the well-known formats, see [`FORMAT_NAMES`].

FullScaleSpec.description: What raw value corresponds to amplitude 1.0.

format.description:
Raw sample format; an automatic `convert` node follows the input. Exactly one of
`format` and `type` must be given.

type.description: Type of already converted samples. Exactly one of `format` and `type` must be given.

InputType.description: The type of an input that delivers already converted samples.

LayoutSpec.description: Component layout of a custom raw format.

oneOf.description: All I values, then all Q values.

capacity.description: Stream outputs only: capacity in samples (default `4 * max_chunk`).

drop.description: What happens when the output is full (default `"error"`).

format.description: Stream outputs only: convert to this raw format (an automatic `convert_out` node).

queue.description: Frame outputs only: queue length in frames (default 4).

underrun.description:
Pull mode: what `pull` does when the source is exhausted (default `"zeros"` for raw
outputs, `"short"` otherwise).

oneOf.description: A stream of samples from a `Block`.

RateHz.description: Sample rate in Hz: a positive integer or an exact fraction "num/den".

event_queue.description:
Capacity of the event queue (default 256, 1 to 65 536). When it is full, the newest
events are dropped and an `events_lost` event is reported later.

max_chunk.description: Largest number of samples accepted per `push` and input (1 to 1 048 576).

pending_params.description:
Capacity of the list of pending timed parameter changes per node (default 16, 1 to
4096).

oneOf.description:
The rest of the request is filled with silence (zero samples) and an `underrun` event
is reported.

groups.description: The node groups by name (optional; nodes without a group are in `"main"`).

oneOf.description: Automatic gain control: scales a complex signal to a constant output amplitude.

group.description: The group of the node (a key of `groups`); nodes without one are in `main`.

attack_s.description: Time constant in seconds when the output is too loud (gain falls). Unit: s. Typical: 0.005 for SSB, 0.1 for AM. Runtime.

initial_gain_db.description: Gain in dB at the start and after a reset; between min_gain_db and max_gain_db. Unit: dB. Typical: 0. Build-time.

max_gain_db.description: Highest gain in dB. Unit: dB. Typical: 60. Runtime.

min_gain_db.description: Lowest gain in dB. Unit: dB. Typical: -20. Runtime.

reference_db.description: Output amplitude in dBFS the loop settles at (a full-scale sample is 0 dB); the linear value must be at least 2^-5. Unit: dB. Typical: -6 (output amplitude 0.5). Runtime.

release_s.description: Time constant in seconds when the output is too quiet (gain rises). Unit: s. Typical: 0.2 for SSB, 0.5 for AM. Runtime.

oneOf.description: Demodulates an AM signal to audio: envelope, DC removal and decimation.

group.description: The group of the node (a key of `groups`); nodes without one are in `main`.

audio_cutoff_hz.description: Cutoff of the audio low-pass in Hz (ignored when audio_decimation is 1). Unit: Hz. Typical: 5e3 for broadcast, 2.5e3 for airband voice. Build-time.

audio_decimation.description: Decimation factor of the audio, 1 to 64. Typical: 1 at 48 kHz, 6 with audio_cutoff_hz 2500 to go to 8 kHz. Build-time.

dc_cutoff_hz.description: -3 dB corner of the DC-blocking high-pass in Hz; 0 switches it off; must be below half the input rate. Unit: Hz. Typical: 30 for broadcast, 0 to switch off. Build-time.

oneOf.description: Filters with a Butterworth low-pass or high-pass, a band-pass or a notch (IIR).

group.description: The group of the node (a key of `groups`); nodes without one are in `main`.

cutoff_hz.description: -3 dB corner of a low-pass or high-pass, centre frequency of a band-pass or notch, in Hz; above 0 and below half the sample rate (for Q15 low-pass and high-pass at least sample rate / 500). Required. Unit: Hz. Typical: 4000 for an AM audio low-pass, 300 to remove CTCSS. Runtime.

order.description: Order of a Butterworth low-pass or high-pass: even, 2 to 8. Must be 2 for band-pass and notch. Typical: 4. Build-time.

q.description: Quality factor of a band-pass or notch; ignored by low-pass and high-pass. Typical: 2 for a band-pass, 10 for a narrow notch. Runtime.

response.description: Shape of the filter. Typical: lowpass for hiss, highpass to remove a sub-tone, notch for a whistle. Build-time.

oneOf.description: Converts raw device bytes in a sample format to complex or real samples.

group.description: The group of the node (a key of `groups`); nodes without one are in `main`.

format.description: Sample format of the input bytes, given by name (for example cu8). Typical: cu8 for RTL-SDR, cs16 for HackRF-class devices. Build-time.

oneOf.description: Converts complex samples to raw device bytes in a sample format.

group.description: The group of the node (a key of `groups`); nodes without one are in `main`.

format.description: Sample format of the output bytes, given by name (for example cs8). Typical: cs8 for HackRF-class transmitters, cs16 for others. Build-time.

oneOf.description: Removes the DC offset of a complex signal with a one-pole high-pass.

group.description: The group of the node (a key of `groups`); nodes without one are in `main`.

cutoff_hz.description: -3 dB corner of the high-pass in Hz; must be below half the sample rate. Unit: Hz. Typical: 10 for a 2.4 MHz receiver. Build-time.

oneOf.description: Shifts a signal to 0 Hz, low-pass filters it and decimates it.

group.description: The group of the node (a key of `groups`); nodes without one are in `main`.

attenuation_db.description: Stop-band attenuation in dB (at least 8). Unit: dB. Typical: 60. Build-time.

cutoff_hz.description: Cutoff (-6 dB point) of the channel filter in Hz. The default is 0.4 * fs / decimation. Unit: Hz. Typical: 100e3 for FM broadcast; default 0.4 times the output rate. Build-time.

decimation.description: Decimation factor, 1 to 1024. Required. Typical: 10 to go from 2.4 MHz to 240 kHz. Build-time.

frequency_hz.description: Frequency of the wanted signal relative to the centre in Hz; it is shifted to 0 Hz. Within plus or minus half the input rate. Unit: Hz. Typical: 600e3 for a carrier 600 kHz above the tuner centre. Runtime.

max_chunk.description: Size of the scratch buffer in samples; larger input is processed in several steps. Unit: samples. Typical: 4096. Build-time.

max_taps.description: Upper limit of the number of taps; a design that needs more fails. Typical: 1023. Build-time.

transition_hz.description: Width of the transition band in Hz. The default is 0.1 * fs / decimation. Unit: Hz. Typical: default 0.1 times the output rate. Build-time.

oneOf.description: Interpolates a signal, removes the images and shifts it up to a carrier frequency.

group.description: The group of the node (a key of `groups`); nodes without one are in `main`.

attenuation_db.description: Image attenuation in dB (at least 8). Unit: dB. Typical: 60. Build-time.

cutoff_hz.description: Cutoff (-6 dB point) of the image filter in Hz. The default is 0.4 * input rate. Unit: Hz. Typical: 100e3 for FM broadcast; default 0.4 times the input rate. Build-time.

frequency_hz.description: Carrier frequency relative to the centre in Hz, within plus or minus half the output rate. Unit: Hz. Typical: 600e3 to transmit 600 kHz above the centre. Runtime.

interpolation.description: Interpolation factor, 1 to 1024. Required. Typical: 10 to go from 240 kHz to 2.4 MHz. Build-time.

max_chunk.description: Size of the scratch buffer in output samples; it must be at least the interpolation factor. Unit: samples. Typical: 4096. Build-time.

max_taps.description: Upper limit of the number of taps; a design that needs more fails. Typical: 1023. Build-time.

transition_hz.description: Width of the transition band in Hz. The default is 0.1 * input rate. Unit: Hz. Typical: default 0.1 times the input rate. Build-time.

oneOf.description: Low-pass FIR filter designed from cutoff, transition width and attenuation.

group.description: The group of the node (a key of `groups`); nodes without one are in `main`.

attenuation_db.description: Stop-band attenuation in dB (at least 8). Unit: dB. Typical: 60. Build-time.

cutoff_hz.description: Cutoff (-6 dB point) in Hz; cutoff plus half the transition width must not exceed half the sample rate. Required. Unit: Hz. Typical: 15e3 for an audio-bandwidth filter at 48 kHz. Build-time.

max_taps.description: Upper limit of the number of taps; a design that needs more fails. Typical: 1023. Build-time.

transition_hz.description: Width of the transition band in Hz, centred on the cutoff. Required. Unit: Hz. Typical: 0.1 times the cutoff. Build-time.

oneOf.description: Demodulates an FM signal to audio with de-emphasis and decimation.

group.description: The group of the node (a key of `groups`); nodes without one are in `main`.

audio_cutoff_hz.description: Cutoff of the audio low-pass in Hz (ignored when audio_decimation is 1). Unit: Hz. Typical: 15e3 for broadcast FM. Build-time.

audio_decimation.description: Decimation factor of the audio, 1 to 64. Typical: 5 to go from 240 kHz to 48 kHz. Build-time.

deemphasis_us.description: Time constant of the de-emphasis in microseconds; 0 switches it off. Unit: us. Typical: 50 in Europe, 75 in North America, 0 to switch off. Build-time.

deviation_hz.description: Peak deviation in Hz that reads full scale (used by C32 only). Unit: Hz. Typical: 75e3 for broadcast FM, 5e3 for narrow-band voice. Build-time.

oneOf.description: Frequency-modulates a real signal onto a complex baseband carrier.

group.description: The group of the node (a key of `groups`); nodes without one are in `main`.

deviation_hz.description: Frequency deviation in Hz for a full-scale input; at most half the sample rate. Unit: Hz. Typical: 75e3 for FM broadcast, 5e3 for narrow-band voice. Runtime.

oneOf.description: Demodulates a broadcast FM signal to stereo audio (left in re, right in im).

group.description: The group of the node (a key of `groups`); nodes without one are in `main`.

audio_cutoff_hz.description: Cutoff of the audio low-pass in Hz, 1 to 16000. Unit: Hz. Typical: 15e3 for broadcast FM. Build-time.

audio_decimation.description: Decimation factor of the audio, 1 to 64. Typical: 10 to go from 480 kHz to 48 kHz. Build-time.

deemphasis_us.description: Time constant of the de-emphasis in microseconds; 0 switches it off. Unit: us. Typical: 50 in Europe, 75 in North America, 0 to switch off. Build-time.

deviation_hz.description: Peak deviation in Hz that reads full scale (C32 and the CQ15 pilot level). Unit: Hz. Typical: 75e3 for broadcast FM. Build-time.

pll_natural_hz.description: Natural frequency of the pilot loop in Hz, 1 to 190. Unit: Hz. Typical: 20. Build-time.

stereo.description: auto decodes stereo while the 19 kHz pilot is present; mono forces mono output (left and right equal). Takes effect from the next call. Typical: auto; mono for a weak station. Runtime.

oneOf.description: Halfband low-pass filter and decimation by 2.

group.description: The group of the node (a key of `groups`); nodes without one are in `main`.

attenuation_db.description: Stop-band attenuation in dB (at least 8). Unit: dB. Typical: 60. Build-time.

max_taps.description: Upper limit of the number of taps; a design that needs more fails. Typical: 1023. Build-time.

transition_hz.description: Width of the transition band in Hz, centred on a quarter of the input rate. The default is 0.1 * fs; it must be below fs / 2. Unit: Hz. Typical: default 0.1 times the input rate. Build-time.

oneOf.description: Turns a real signal into a complex one at half the rate (fs/4 shift and halfband).

group.description: The group of the node (a key of `groups`); nodes without one are in `main`.

attenuation_db.description: Stop-band attenuation in dB (at least 8). Unit: dB. Typical: 60. Build-time.

max_taps.description: Upper limit of the number of taps; a design that needs more fails. Typical: 1023. Build-time.

transition_hz.description: Width of the transition band in Hz, centred on a quarter of the input rate. The default is 0.1 * fs; it must be below fs / 2. Unit: Hz. Typical: default 0.1 times the input rate. Build-time.

oneOf.description: Changes the sample rate by a rational factor, optionally tunable in ppm.

group.description: The group of the node (a key of `groups`); nodes without one are in `main`.

attenuation_db.description: Stop-band attenuation in dB (at least 8). Unit: dB. Typical: 60. Build-time.

cutoff_hz.description: Cutoff (-6 dB point) of the anti-alias filter in Hz. The default is 0.45 * min(rate_in, rate_out). Unit: Hz. Typical: default 0.45 times the lower of the input and output rates. Build-time.

max_taps.description: Upper limit of the number of taps (of the whole filter in the rational mode, per phase in the tunable mode); a design that needs more fails. Typical: 1023; 8192 for 48000 to 44100 in the rational mode. Build-time.

ppm.description: Correction of the output rate in parts per million; changes only with tunable = true. Unit: ppm. Typical: 0; +100 makes the output rate 100 ppm higher. Runtime.

rate_out_hz.description: Output sample rate in Hz, a whole number. Required. Unit: Hz. Typical: 48000 for audio. Build-time.

transition_hz.description: Width of the transition band in Hz. The default is 0.1 * min(rate_in, rate_out). Unit: Hz. Typical: default 0.1 times the lower of the input and output rates. Build-time.

tunable.description: Use the 128-phase tunable resampler; required for the ppm parameter. Typical: false; true to follow a drifting clock. Build-time.

oneOf.description: Multiplies a complex signal by a gain given in decibels.

group.description: The group of the node (a key of `groups`); nodes without one are in `main`.

gain_db.description: Gain in dB; at most +40 for C32 and at most 0 for CQ15. Unit: dB. Typical: 0 for unity gain, -6 to halve the amplitude. Runtime.

oneOf.description: Computes averaged power spectra in dB relative to full scale as frames.

group.description: The group of the node (a key of `groups`); nodes without one are in `main`.

averaging.description: Number of windows whose power is averaged into one frame. Typical: 1; 10 for a smoother display. Runtime.

fft_size.description: Number of FFT points, a power of two from 16 to 65536. Typical: 1024; 4096 for finer resolution. Build-time.

interval_samples.description: Distance between the starts of consecutive windows in samples. The default is fft_size. Smaller values overlap the windows. Unit: samples. Typical: default fft_size; fft_size / 2 for 50 % overlap. Runtime.

kaiser_beta.description: Shape parameter of the Kaiser window (used only for window = kaiser). Typical: 8.6. Build-time.

window.description: Window function: hann, blackman_harris or kaiser. Typical: hann. Build-time.

oneOf.description: Passes a complex signal only while its average power is above a threshold.

group.description: The group of the node (a key of `groups`); nodes without one are in `main`.

hysteresis_db.description: The gate closes this many dB below threshold_db. Unit: dB. Typical: 3. Runtime.

tau_s.description: Time constant of the power average in seconds. Unit: s. Typical: 0.01 at 48 kHz. Build-time.

threshold_db.description: Level in dBFS at which the gate opens. Unit: dB. Typical: -40 for a strong local signal, -55 for weak signals. Runtime.

oneOf.description: Demodulates a single-sideband signal (USB or LSB) to audio.

group.description: The group of the node (a key of `groups`); nodes without one are in `main`.

attenuation_db.description: Stop-band attenuation in dB (at least 8). Unit: dB. Typical: 60. Build-time.

audio_decimation.description: Decimation factor of the audio, 1 to 64. Typical: 1 at 48 kHz, 6 to go to 8 kHz. Build-time.

high_hz.description: Upper edge of the audio band in Hz, from the carrier; above low_hz. Unit: Hz. Typical: 3000 for voice. Build-time.

low_hz.description: Lower edge of the audio band in Hz, from the carrier. Unit: Hz. Typical: 300 for voice. Build-time.

max_taps.description: Upper limit of the number of taps; a design that needs more fails. Typical: 1023. Build-time.

sideband.description: Sideband to receive: usb (above the carrier) or lsb (below). Typical: usb; lsb for amateur radio below 10 MHz. Runtime.

transition_hz.description: Width of the transition band of the filter in Hz. Unit: Hz. Typical: 200. Build-time.
